preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2000) and k (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9) separated by space.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c in (' ', '-') for line in stdin.splitlines() for c in line)
preconditions.description: All input characters are digits, spaces, or minus signs (for coordinate values).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no solution' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(stdin.split()[0]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'no solution' or exactly n lines of two integers each (coordinates), with all points distinct and |xi|, |yi| ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != 'no solution' and any(all(int(line.split()[0]) == 0 and int(line.split()[1]) == j for j, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if j < int(stdin.split()[0])) for _ in range(1))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must force the given code's tot > k by constructing points where the break condition (p[j].x - p[i].x >= d) is never triggered early, causing O(n^2) comparisons.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no solution' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(stdin.split()[0]) and all(abs(int(line.split()[0])) <= 10**9 and abs(int(line.split()[1])) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the output satisfy |xi|, |yi| ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no solution' or len({tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()}) == int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: All points in the output are distinct.
